answer: The kite-maker workshop smells of bamboo and paste, and the split canes lie bundled by the door. Proof of kite-maker via bamboo frame tally — a kite the kite-maker frames only after 27 kites fly true without one frame snapping, each kite framed by the kite-maker himself. atlas splits the cane thin and trims each piece to length. crystal pastes the paper over the frame and smooths it flat. harbor ties the bridle string and tests the kite in the wind. Twenty-seven kites must fly true without one frame snapping, and the next still dives where the bridle ran slack.
